example.pinyin: Tā de háizi jīnnián wǔ suì.
example.gloss: Her child is five years old this year.

vocab.gloss: to leave; to part (from); (literary) to differentiate; to distinguish; (bound form) other; another; different

example.pinyin: Hěn wǎn le, bié kàn diànshì le.
example.gloss: It's late — don't watch TV anymore.

example.pinyin: Wǒ bàba de gōngsī zài Táiběi.
example.gloss: My dad's company is in Taipei.

example.hanzi: 這是我第一次吃臭豆腐。
example.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì chī chòudòufu.
example.gloss: This is my first time eating stinky tofu.

example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng wèn lǎoshī yí ge wèntí.
example.gloss: I want to ask the teacher a question.

example.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī de míngzi hěn cháng.
example.gloss: Our company's name is very long.

grammar.title: 別 + Verb：Don't do that
grammar.explanation: 別 before a verb tells someone not to do something. It is softer and more spoken than 不要. Adding 了 at the end means 'stop doing it now'. It is very common in everyday Taiwan speech: 別問了、別走那麼快。

examples.pinyin: Tài wǎn le, bié hē kāfēi le.
examples.gloss: It's too late — stop drinking coffee.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 小明，明天是你第一天去新公司嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiǎo Míng, míngtiān shì nǐ dì yī tiān qù xīn gōngsī ma?
dialogue.gloss: Xiao Ming, is tomorrow your first day at the new company?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊，公司就在台北車站附近。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, gōngsī jiù zài Táiběi chēzhàn fùjìn.
dialogue.gloss: Yes, the company is right near Taipei Main Station.

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.pinyin: Nà nǐ yào dā jiéyùn qù ma?
dialogue.gloss: So are you taking the MRT there?

dialogue.speaker: 小明
dialogue.hanzi: 對，我想問你，那裡的路遠不遠？
dialogue.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng wèn nǐ, nàlǐ de lù yuǎn bù yuǎn?
dialogue.gloss: Yes. I want to ask you — is the walk there far?

dialogue.speaker: 小安
dialogue.hanzi: 不遠，路也不長，別想太多，早一點去就好。
dialogue.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, lù yě bù cháng, bié xiǎng tài duō, zǎo yìdiǎn qù jiù hǎo.
dialogue.gloss: Not far, and the road isn't long either. Don't overthink it — just go a bit early.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ dì yī cì lái zhè jiā gōngsī.
sentences.gloss: This is my first time coming to this company.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège háizi hěn xǐhuān chī miàn.
sentences.gloss: This child really likes eating noodles.
Who do you want to ask?

vocab.gloss: to press charges; to file a complaint

example.pinyin: Wǒ yào gàosù nǐ yí jiàn shìqíng.
example.gloss: I want to tell you something.

example.hanzi: 這件事情我已經知道了。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng wǒ yǐjīng zhīdào le.
example.gloss: I already know about this matter.

vocab.gloss: ordinal number; day of a month; mark

example.gloss: He is a little taller than me.

vocab.gloss: item; component; classifier for events, things, clothes etc

example.hanzi: 這件事情很小，別想太多。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng hěn xiǎo, bié xiǎng tài duō.
example.gloss: This is a small matter, don't overthink it.

vocab.gloss: to open up; to spread; sheet of paper

example.pinyin: Wǒ yào mǎi liǎng zhāng huǒchē piào.
example.gloss: I want to buy two train tickets.

grammar.title: 量詞「件」和「張」
grammar.pattern: 數字 + 件/張 + 名詞
grammar.explanation: 在中文裡，名詞前面要用量詞。「件」用在事情、衣服上面，例如「一件事情」；「張」用在很平的東西上面，例如票、卡、帳單，例如「一張票」、「一張悠遊卡」。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào.

examples.hanzi: 這件事情你告訴他了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng nǐ gàosù tā le ma?
examples.gloss: Did you tell him about this matter?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhāng Yōuyóukǎ.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 喂，你在哪裡？我有一件事情要告訴你。
dialogue.pinyin: Wéi, nǐ zài nǎlǐ? Wǒ yǒu yí jiàn shìqíng yào gàosù nǐ.
dialogue.gloss: Hello, where are you? I have something to tell you.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 我在火車站，我要買兩張票。什麼事情？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ zài huǒchē zhàn, wǒ yào mǎi liǎng zhāng piào. Shénme shìqíng?
dialogue.gloss: I'm at the train station buying two tickets. What is it?

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 週末有颱風，票錢也很高，我們下個月再去吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhōumò yǒu táifēng, piào qián yě hěn gāo, wǒmen xià ge yuè zài qù ba.
dialogue.gloss: There's a typhoon this weekend and ticket prices are high; let's go next month.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo a, nà xià ge yuè jǐ hào?
dialogue.gloss: OK, so what date next month?

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 十五號好嗎？那天是晴天喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Shíwǔ hào hǎo ma? Nà tiān shì qíngtiān o.
dialogue.gloss: How about the 15th? It'll be sunny that day.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.hanzi: 好，那我現在不買票了，謝謝你告訴我。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ xiànzài bù mǎi piào le, xièxie nǐ gàosù wǒ.
dialogue.gloss: OK, then I won't buy tickets now. Thanks for telling me.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yào gàosù nǐ yí jiàn shìqíng.
sentences.gloss: I want to tell you one thing.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng wǒ zhīdào le.

vocab.gloss: to go forward; to advance; to go in

example.pinyin: Qǐng jìn, wàimiàn zài xià yǔ.
example.gloss: Come in please, it's raining outside.

example.hanzi: 我每天都騎腳踏車上班。
example.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu qí jiǎotàchē shàngbān.
example.gloss: I ride my bike to work every day.

vocab.gloss: you (courteous, as opposed to informal 你)

example.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐngwèn yào hē shénme?
example.gloss: Hello, what would you like to drink?

example.pinyin: Wǒ sòng nǐ yì zhāng Yōuyóukǎ.

vocab.gloss: to laugh; to smile; to laugh at

example.gloss: She smiled and said thank you.

grammar.title: 每⋯⋯都⋯⋯ (every ... all)
grammar.pattern: 每 + (量詞/時間) + 都 + 動詞
grammar.explanation: 每 means "each/every". In Mandarin, a sentence with 每 usually adds 都 before the verb to show that the action happens without exception. 每天、每次、每個週末 are very common time phrases in daily Taiwan speech.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.gloss: I drink a cup of coffee every day.

examples.hanzi: 他每個週末都去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi ge zhōumò dōu qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.gloss: He goes to see a movie every weekend.

examples.hanzi: 她每次都笑著說沒關係。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì dōu xiàozhe shuō méi guānxi.
examples.gloss: Every time she smiles and says it's no problem.

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.pinyin: Nín hǎo, qǐng jìn, qǐng zuò!
dialogue.gloss: Hello, come in, please have a seat!

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 謝謝。我想吃麵，也要一杯紅茶。
dialogue.pinyin: Xièxie. Wǒ xiǎng chī miàn, yě yào yì bēi hóngchá.
dialogue.gloss: Thanks. I'd like noodles, and also a black tea.

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.hanzi: 好，我們現在準備，十分鐘就好。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen xiànzài zhǔnbèi, shí fēnzhōng jiù hǎo.
dialogue.gloss: OK, we'll prepare it now; ten minutes and it'll be ready.

dialogue.speaker: 客人
dialogue.hanzi: 我還要一個便當，可以帶走嗎？
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ hái yào yí ge biàndāng, kěyǐ dàizǒu ma?
dialogue.gloss: I also want a lunchbox — can I take it to go?

dialogue.speaker: 老闆
dialogue.hanzi: 可以喔，我也可以送到您家。
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ o, wǒ yě kěyǐ sòng dào nín jiā.
dialogue.gloss: Sure, I can also deliver it to your home.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān dōu zǒulù shàngbān.
sentences.gloss: I walk to work every day.
The boss asks you to come in.

sentences.pinyin: Māma sòng wǒ yí ge biàndāng.

sentences.gloss: He smiled and said it's fine.
